revisions.text: What's the deal with the book? Is it like one of those things where you bring it with you on vacation everywhere but never actually read it, but you’re like "hey I'm going to keep bringing it with me, because the moment I don't do it I'm admitting to myself that I don't see things through" and the next thing you know it's 4 years later and you're still on chapter 3 and you forgot who Heathcliff was so you have to start over?
